Title: Public preview of Azure Database – Flexible Server now available in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server public preview is now available in the West US and Germany West Central regions. Now you can enjoy a simplified provisioning experience in these regions with experience such as: 

  • Optimized lower total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKU 
  • Access to the stop/start feature
  • Access to the storage auto grow feature
  • More control with scheduled maintenance 
  • Access to the same-zone high availability feature
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption

Learn more by reading the documentation and visit the Azure Database for MySQL products available by region page to learn more about regional availability.
